left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria-- Participants must be:
  -  Healthy (determined by self-report)
  -  Between the ages of 18-55 years old
  -  Current cigarette smokers
  -  Wiling to provide informed consent
  -  Able to attend the lab session and abstain from tobacco/nicotine products as required
  -  Agree to use designated products according to the study protocol
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Women if they are breast-feeding  [OR] or test positive for pregnancy (by urinalysis) at screening

right.raw_text: -  Individuals who weigh less than 110 pounds

left.raw_text: Some study details about the eligibility criteria are purposely omitted at this time to preserve scientific integrity

right.raw_text: Full details will be posted at the conclusion of the study
